title: MACD trend, 12, 26 and 9 days
author: arhancanli
rationale: Holds when a faster average of the price is gaining on a slower one. It is a very widely used way to describe the direction and pace of a trend.
risks: It is built from past prices, so it reacts late and can give many false signals when a market moves sideways. Being so widely known, it offers no information others lack.
references: Appel (2005), Technical Analysis: Power Tools for Active Investors, FT Press
